# kinsta_dns_record (Resource)

Manages one record set on Kinsta DNS: every value of one name and type in a zone. Use the `kinsta_dns_zone` data source to look up a zone's ID by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kinsta_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "kinsta_dns_record" "apex" {
  zone_id = data.kinsta_dns_zone.example.id
  name    = "@"
  type    = "A"
  values  = ["192.0.2.10"]
}

resource "kinsta_dns_record" "www" {
  zone_id = data.kinsta_dns_zone.example.id
  name    = "www"
  type    = "CNAME"
  values  = ["example.com"]
}

resource "kinsta_dns_record" "mx" {
  zone_id = data.kinsta_dns_zone.example.id
  name    = "@"
  type    = "MX"
  values  = ["1 aspmx.l.google.com", "5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com"]
}

# TXT values may be written bare; they are quoted the way Kinsta DNS stores them.
resource "kinsta_dns_record" "spf" {
  zone_id = data.kinsta_dns_zone.example.id
  name    = "@"
  type    = "TXT"
  values  = ["v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com -all"]
  ttl     = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Record name: `@` for the zone apex, a name relative to the zone (`www`), or a fully qualified name inside the zone (`www.example.com`). A trailing dot marks a name as absolute. Changing it to another spelling of the same name (say `www` to `www.example.com`) does not replace the record.
- `type` (String) Record type in upper case, e.g. `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `SRV` or `CAA`.
- `values` (Set of String) The record's values, in zone-file form: `10 mail.example.com` for MX, `10 5 443 target.example.com` for SRV. TXT values may be written bare (`v=spf1 -all`): they are quoted and split into 255-character strings the way Kinsta DNS stores them, and a bare value and its quoted form are treated as equal.
- `zone_id` (String) ID of the Kinsta DNS zone.

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds, at least 300. Defaults to 3600.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified record name, lowercase and without the trailing dot.
- `id` (String) `<zone_id>/<type>/<fqdn>`.
- `zone_name` (String) Name of the zone, e.g. `example.com`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <zone_id>/<type>/<fully qualified name>.
terraform import kinsta_dns_record.spf 0757c118-0000-4000-8000-000000000000/TXT/example.com
```
